data.one_liner: Check eSIM support and install eSIM profiles on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides an API to query if a device supports eSIM and to install eSIM profiles. It also offers a helper to get installation instructions.
use_when: You need to verify eSIM capability before enabling related features
You want to programmatically install an eSIM profile
You need a quick way to display eSIM setup instructions
avoid_when: You lack Apple eSIM entitlement or are targeting only Android
You need advanced profile management beyond installation
weaknesses: Requires Apple entitlement for profile installation
Android support limited to basic checks
data.setup_notes: No native configuration required; just add dependency and import
